segments.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: אִיסְטָטִית הִיא זוֹ כּוּ׳.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that «Rabbi Yehuda says» that if a single set of witnesses rendered numerous sets of witnesses, all of whom testified that one person killed another, conspiring witnesses, «this» situation «is a conspiracy,» and only the first set of conspiring witnesses is executed.
